description: This file defines a handler class for processing OpenAI audio transcription responses with guardrails support. It provides methods to handle the input (which is audio and thus not processed for guardrails) and to process the output response by applying guardrails to transcribed text.

classes.name: OpenAIAudioTranscriptionHandler
classes.description: Handler class for processing OpenAI audio transcription responses with guardrail support.

methods.name: Any process_input_messages( self, data: dict, guardrail_to_apply: "CustomGuardrail", litellm_logging_obj: Optional[Any] = None, )
methods.description: Process input data, which is audio, so guardrail processing is not applicable; returns data unchanged.

methods.name: Any process_output_response( self, response: "TranscriptionResponse", guardrail_to_apply: "CustomGuardrail", litellm_logging_obj: Optional[Any] = None, user_api_key_dict: Optional[Any] = None, )
methods.description: Process output transcription response, applying guardrails to the transcribed text and returning the modified response.
